marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots early this afternoon
and to northwest 20 near midnight. Wind diminishing to northwest 15 Monday
afternoon and to light Monday evening. Showers changing to snow this evening then to flurries
Monday afternoon. Fog banks dissipating near noon. Visibility 1 mile or less in
fog banks and as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near plus 1. <br/>
